- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover

- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Compact Layout Pick Friend Selection Redesign: Redesign the pet choice interface to use a compact layout so users can view available pets simultaneously without scrolling. (why: Adoption step has a significant drop-off (60.9% conversion) and takes a long median time of 89s. A compact layout simplifies comparison.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Companion Overview Welcome Screen: Introduce a dedicated overview screen right before pet selection detailing companion interaction styles. (why: Users take median 89s in adoption and support receives queries regarding how desktop pets behave and interact.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Interactive Desktop Controls Onboarding Flow: Add an interactive setup flow screen right before home intro explaining mouse shortcuts, dock position, and hide toggles. (why: Support logged multiple emails complaining about unclear controls for hiding or talking to the pet post-onboarding, and finish conversion drops to 68.0%.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Card Layout Story Intro Screen Redesign: Redesign the story introduction screen using a clean card layout to clearly present the app's core value upfront. (why: Choose path has a high mean time of 514s; presenting a structured card layout reduces decision friction.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Pet Save Protection Hint: Display an inline hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that signing in links and preserves pet data across restarts. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again. Sign-in hints have proven effective in previous rounds.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Spawn Alert System Notification: Enable desktop notification triggers on the waiting screen to alert users when the pet finishes rendering and appears on screen. (why: Support noted 3 issues where pets failed to show or users thought the app stalled. Waiting step median time is 201s.)
6: [finish, copy] Home Intro Companion Interaction Copy Update: Update the final welcome headline and body text to give explicit instructions on interacting with and hiding the pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to pets after completing setup.)
7: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Step Progress Timer Display: Display active step counters and estimated remaining time on the waiting screen while desktop assets compile. (why: Home waiting stage has a high mean time of 2336s (median 201s), leading to user drop-off during background loading.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Compact Split Path Selection Layout: Switch the choose_path screen layout to compact view to highlight companion paths efficiently. (why: Choose path takes a mean 514s; presenting path options in a compact layout improves evaluation speed.)
